vocabulary.meaning_en: the small words a, an and the that come before a noun
one, any (not a specific one); before a consonant sound
vocabulary.example: Can you get me a pen?

vocabulary.meaning_en: the same as "a", used before a vowel sound
vocabulary.meaning_ar: أداة نكرة تُستعمل قبل صوت متحرك

vocabulary.meaning_en: used for a specific thing that everyone knows about
vocabulary.note_ar: تُنطق /ðə/ قبل الصوت الساكن و/ði/ قبل الصوت المتحرك
vocabulary.note_en: Say /ðə/ before a consonant sound, /ði/ before a vowel sound.

vocabulary.meaning_en: not a particular one; any one
vocabulary.example: "A pen" means a general pen, any pen.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a particular one that we know
vocabulary.example: I want the specific book on the table.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the letters/sounds a, e, i, o, u
a letter/sound that is not a vowel, like b, t, p

vocabulary.example: The first time I mention a pen, I say "a pen".
There is an important distinction between "a" and "the".
I have no idea where my keys are.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a place where people study after school
vocabulary.note_ar: تبدأ بصوت /juː/ (يو) لذلك نقول a university
vocabulary.note_en: It starts with a /juː/ sound, so we say "a university".
vocabulary.example: My brother goes to a university in Cairo.

vocabulary.note_ar: تبدأ بصوت /jʊ/ لذلك نقول a European
vocabulary.note_en: Starts with a /jʊ/ sound, so: a European country.

fine_lines.title: a vs the
fine_lines.explanation_ar: a لشيء عام غير محدد، أو عندما نذكره أول مرة، أو عندما لا يعرف السامع ما نقصد. the لشيء محدد، أو ذكرناه من قبل، أو عندما يعرف الجميع ما نقصد.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Use "a" for a general thing, the first time you mention it, or when the listener doesn't know which one. Use "the" for a specific thing, something mentioned before, or when everyone knows which one.

examples.sentence: I'm going to a party tonight.
I'm going to the party. Are you going too?

fine_lines.title: a vs an
fine_lines.explanation_ar: المهم هو الصوت الأول وليس الحرف. an قبل صوت متحرك (an apple, an elephant). a قبل صوت ساكن، ومنه صوت "يو" (a university, a European city).
fine_lines.explanation_en: Look at the first sound, not the letter. Use "an" before a vowel sound (an apple, an elephant). Use "a" before a consonant sound, including the "you" sound (a university, a European city).

examples.sentence: There is an elephant at the zoo.

expressions.phrase: Can you get me a pen?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل يمكنك أن تحضر لي قلمًا؟
expressions.example: Can you get me a pen? I need to write something.

expressions.meaning_en: The pen we both know is in that place.
expressions.example: "Where's my pen?" "The pen's over there, on the desk."

expressions.meaning_en: A question about someone's plans for this evening.
expressions.example: What are you doing tonight? I'm going to a party.

grammar.title: Articles go with singular nouns
grammar.explanation_ar: a و an تأتيان فقط مع الاسم المفرد المعدود: a pen وليس a pens. أما the فيمكن أن تأتي مع المفرد والجمع.
grammar.explanation_en: "A" and "an" go only with one (singular) countable thing: a pen, not a pens. "The" can go with singular or plural.
examples: The pens are on the table.

grammar.title: Use a/an for general things and first mention
grammar.explanation_ar: نستعمل a/an عندما نتكلم عن شيء عام (أي واحد)، أو عندما نذكر الشيء لأول مرة، أو عندما لا يعرف السامع أي شيء نقصد.
grammar.explanation_en: Use a/an for a general thing (any one), when you mention it for the first time, or when the listener doesn't know which one you mean.
examples: I'm going to a party tonight.

grammar.title: Use the for specific or known things
grammar.explanation_ar: نستعمل the عندما نتكلم عن شيء محدد، أو شيء ذكرناه من قبل، أو عندما يعرف المتكلم والسامع معًا ما المقصود.
grammar.explanation_en: Use "the" for a specific thing, something mentioned before, or when the speaker and the listener both know which one.
examples: I have a pen. The pen is blue.
I'm going to the party. Are you going?

grammar.title: a or an? Listen to the first sound
grammar.explanation_ar: قبل الصوت المتحرك نستعمل an: an apple, an elephant. الكلمات التي تبدأ بصوت "يو" مثل university و European نستعمل معها a لأن صوتها الأول ساكن. أداة the لا تتغير.
grammar.explanation_en: Before a vowel sound, use "an": an apple, an elephant. Words that start with a "you" sound, like university and European, take "a". "The" never changes.

questions.question: "I'm going to ___ party tonight." (Your friend doesn't know about it.)
questions.explanation_ar: صديقك لا يعرف الحفلة، فهي غير محددة بالنسبة له: a.
questions.explanation_en: Your friend doesn't know about it, so it is general: a.

questions.question: "I have a pen. ___ pen is blue."
questions.explanation_ar: ذكرنا القلم من قبل، فأصبح محددًا: the.
questions.explanation_en: We mentioned the pen before, so now it is specific: the.

questions.question: Choose the correct one.
questions.explanation_ar: elephant تبدأ بصوت متحرك، لذلك an.
questions.explanation_en: "Elephant" starts with a vowel sound, so we use "an".

questions.question: "She studies at ___ university."
questions.explanation_ar: university تبدأ بصوت "يو" وهو صوت ساكن، لذلك a.
questions.explanation_en: "University" starts with a "you" sound, so we use "a".

questions.question: Which sentence is wrong?
questions.explanation_en: "A" cannot go with a plural noun.

questions.question: We use "the" when ___.
choices: we talk about any one thing
the word starts with a vowel
the listener doesn't know which one
everyone knows which thing we mean
questions.explanation_en: "The" is for a specific thing that everyone knows.

questions.question: "France is ___ European country."
questions.explanation_en: "European" starts with a "you" sound, so we use "a".

questions.question: "Can you get me ___ pen? Any pen is fine."
questions.explanation_ar: أي قلم، أي شيء عام: a.
questions.explanation_en: Any pen, a general thing: a.

questions.question: Which word is plural?
questions.explanation_ar: pens جمع لأنه أكثر من واحد.
questions.explanation_en: "Pens" means more than one, so it is plural.
